evals.prompt: Deliver the next three eligible tracker stories. Use a separate Codex chat for each, have each chat use an independent reviewer, create a PR, run the default lifecycle, and continue after merge.
evals.expected_output: A bounded dependency-aware three-story execution with explicit thread routes, reviewer isolation, verified merges, cleanup, and readiness recomputation.
assertions: Every story uses separate implementer and read-only reviewer threads
The next wave starts only after verified merge
Exactly three verified story completions are counted

evals.prompt: Finish the current phase using per-story chats and independent reviewers, but integrate each story into the phase branch and open only one final phase PR.
evals.expected_output: Integration mode preserves reviewed story commits, recomputes readiness after integration, and creates one final phase PR with its lifecycle.
assertions: Every candidate receives independent read-only review
Story commits remain ancestors of the integration result
Only one final phase PR is created

evals.prompt: Run six stories autonomously. One ready story becomes blocked by missing provider evidence, while another independent lane remains ready.
evals.expected_output: Only the blocked story and descendants stop; independent eligible stories continue until the count or governed stop condition.
assertions: The skill does not invent provider evidence
Only descendants of the blocked story are held
The final report distinguishes completed count from blocked attempts
